1  this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 60  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256 - 64  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  survivorState = #TENTACLE  ThisWidth = this.width  thisHalfHeight = this.height / 2  grabCount = 0  distToHQ = 0  frameDir = 1endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case survivorState of      #TENTACLE:        survivorDelay = survivorDelay + 1        if survivorDelay >= 5 then          survivorDelay = 0          if ((thisMember + frameDir) > (startMember + 2)) or ((thisMember + frameDir) < startMember) then            frameDir = -frameDir          end if          thisMember = thisMember + frameDir          this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")        end if      #ONCABLE:        this.loc = cableGuy.loc        if gCableLength = 0 then          gCableItem = 0          survivorState = #INCOPTER          gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1          gScore = gScore + 500          puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          gRescuedList.add(this)        end if      #INCOPTER:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000      #GOTOHQ:        thisMember = thisMember + 1        if thisMember > (startMember + 2) then          thisMember = startMember        end if        this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")        if distToHQ <= 0 then          Xvel = 0          this.blend = this.blend - 5          if this.blend <= 0 then            survivorState = #HOME            gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1            gScore = gScore + 1000            puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          end if        end if        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset + Xvel        distToHQ = distToHQ + Xvel        Ypos = 270        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos      #HOME:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000    end case  end ifend
